description: Run an R script against an upstream DataFrame. Two backends: rpy2 (in-process) or Rscript (subprocess + parquet/csv handoff).

inputs.description: Upstream DataFrame; available to the R script as `df`

outputs.description: The R script must assign its result to `out_df`. Returned to Dagster as pandas DataFrame.

script.label: R Script
script.description: R script body. Reads `df`, must assign `out_df`.

rscript_executable.description: Path to the `Rscript` binary (only used when backend='rscript').
rscript_executable.label: Rscript Binary Path

intermediate_format.description: On-disk format for the DataFrame handoff to/from R: 'parquet' (requires arrow R pkg) or 'csv'.
intermediate_format.label: Handoff Format (rscript backend)

r_packages.description: R packages to ensure are installed before running the script. Pre-install in your runtime image for production.
r_packages.label: R Packages To Install

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds the R subprocess may run (rscript backend only).
timeout_seconds.label: Rscript Timeout (seconds)

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps
